tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create an agent API key without an account. A short library search is free. The rest of the library needs Library Pro, $19 a month, on a claimed key. Live App Store lookup of the user's own app works with the key. Restyle and localize require the human to open claim_url, sign in, and pay.

tools.name: list_directory_categories
tools.description: List App Store screenshot directory categories (Finance, Food & Drink, Productivity, …) with app counts. Use this first when an agent wants inspiration by genre. A short search is free. The rest of the library is Library Pro, $19 a month.

tools.name: list_directory_tags
tools.description: List listing-screenshot treatments (headline, device-frame, lifestyle, dark, character, social-proof, …) with app counts. These are App Store creative tags, not in-app UI patterns. A short search is free. The rest of the library is Library Pro, $19 a month.

tools.name: list_directory_apps
tools.description: Search thousands of real App Store listings (the top 100 free and top-grossing apps in every Apple category, refreshed daily). Filter by text, Apple genre slug, listing look (tag), today's chart rank, or apps that have preview videos. Returns slugs for get_directory_app, get_app_videos, get_app_hist

tools.name: get_directory_app
tools.description: Get one directory app: metadata, ordered listing screenshots, app preview posters, and in-app event photos (as markdown images), related apps in the same genre, and the create_restyle arguments to copy that style. Without Library Pro this returns 3 screenshots. The rest, similar apps, and other coun

tools.name: get_directory_screens
tools.description: Get the ordered App Store listing screenshots for a library app, including markdown images a vision model can inspect. Pass country (jp, de, ...) for that storefront's screenshots and in-app events. Index is 1-based and matches /apps/:slug/screens/:index. Without Library Pro this returns the first 3

tools.name: get_app_videos
tools.description: App Store preview videos for a library app, including 1-hour download links to the mp4 files. Needs Library Pro, $19 a month. Pass slug from list_directory_apps.

tools.name: get_app_history
tools.description: Every version of an app's App Store listing we have captured (screenshots and preview videos per date), newest first. Needs Library Pro, $19 a month.

tools.name: get_magicscreenshots_site_summary
tools.description: Return a concise summary of MagicScreenshots, the screenshot directory, public routes, MCP tools, and auth requirements.

tools.name: get_magicscreenshots_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a markdown representation of a known MagicScreenshots public page.

tools.name: get_magicscreenshots_discovery_document
tools.description: Fetch a known agent discovery document such as API catalog, Agent Skills, MCP, OAuth metadata, OpenAPI, or llms.txt.

tools.name: list_magicscreenshots_languages
tools.description: Return supported screenshot localization languages and public guide routes.

tools.name: list_magicscreenshots_markets
tools.description: Return supported App Store market guides and public market routes.

tools.name: get_screenshots
tools.description: Fetch high-resolution App Store screenshots. Directory shots return 3 screenshots without Library Pro. The rest of the listing is $19 a month. Pass live=true to look up the current App Store listing of the user's own app (API key required). Use get_directory_app when you already have a catalog slug.

tools.name: create_restyle
tools.description: Restyle the user's App Store screenshots to match a directory inspiration set. Prefer inspiration_slug from list_directory_apps (duolingo, monzo, doordash, …). Requires an API key; the human must claim the key and pay before generation runs.

tools.name: create_localize
tools.description: Create MagicScreenshots localization jobs for source App Store screenshots across one or more target locales.

tools.name: approve_restyle
tools.description: Approve a generated restyle overview and start final screenshot extraction.

tools.name: get_job_group
tools.description: Check restyle job group status, overview URL, errors, and final output URLs.

tools.name: list_results
tools.description: List recent MagicScreenshots restyle job groups and outputs for the authenticated account.
